_comment: Kill-gates: bars this project committed to in public, each with a registry that answers it. There are no dates here on purpose — a gate is a BAR, not a deadline, and a published date is a promise about a calendar that nothing in this repository can verify. A gate is never met by assertion: `node tools/campaign.mjs gates` reads the count from the declared source. When a gate is read, the reading is recorded with `record` — which appends to `history` with the count at that moment and regenerates campaign/GATES.md. Editing `history` by hand defeats the entire mechanism.

gates.name: Demand evidence — structured operator interviews
gates.target: completed 25-minute interviews with people who run agents that act
gates.source: the local tracker (campaign/tracker.local.json) — the count is publishable, the people are not (D-036)

gates.name: Independent verification — external attestations
gates.target: distinct external parties who each verified a fresh challenge and signed an execution-bound attestation
gates.source: tools/genesis-board/board.mjs — it re-verifies each attestation's signature and only counts ones the maintainer confirmed against the private answer key
